data.title: Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Receives Pakistani Ambassador to Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs Waleed Elkhereiji received Ambassador of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan to Saudi Arabia Ahmad Farooq today at the ministry's headquarters in Riyadh.
    During the meeting, they reviewed ways to enhance cooperation between the two countries in all fields and discussed issues of mutual interest.
    -- SPA
17:40 Local Time 14:40 GMT
0051
